wording: [Water Dome of the Deep Sea Currents]
holderQuote: Revine was not so happy about their proximity, though.
effectQuote: Her magic was more adaptive than he thought. He had no conception that she could use the dome of water offensively like that.

wording: [Water Dome of the Deep Sea Currents]
holderQuote: And the Siren laughed at him. She laughed—and popped out of place on her palanquin.
effectQuote: All the water she had shot in their fight—returned to Revine and reformed that deadly dome.
